div.head: Ine 54.2
div.ab: Witeðeowne mon Wiliscne mon sceal bedrifan be XII hidum swa ðeowne to swingum, Engliscne be XXXIIII hida.
Witeðeowne monnan Wyliscne mon sceal bedrifan be XII hidum swa ðeowne to swingum, Engliscne be feower ⁊ XXX hida.
Wita-(id est forisfactura)-seruus homo Waliscus debet superiurari per duodecim hidas sic[ut] seruus ad uerbera, Anglicus homo per triginta quatuor hidas.
Witeðeowne monnan wyliscne mon sceal bedrifan be XII hidum swa ðeowne to swingum, Engliscne be feower ⁊ XXX hida.
A Welshman in the position of penal slave shall be forced to be lashed like a slave [by an oath of] twelve hides; an Englishman by [an oath of] thirty-four hides.1
A Welshman, who has been reduced to penal slavery, shall be compelled to submit to a scourging, as a slave, by [an oath of] 12 hides; an Englishman, by [an oath of] 34 hides.
A penally enslaved Welshman shall be compelled to [suffer] a flogging as a slave by [an oath of] 12 hides, an Englishman by [an oath of] 34 hides.
Einen strafhörigen Wälschen Mann soll [kann] man wie einen Sklaven durch [Eid von] 12 Hiden zur [Erleidung der] Prügelstrafe treiben, einen Englischen durch 34 Hiden.
A Welshman who is a penalty-slave may be driven to [suffer] the flogging like a slave by [an oath of] 12 hides; an Englishman by 34 hides.
div.note: The original reading may have been 24, double the oath for a Welshman.
